text: Try to meet some new people, you will be shocked at how fast you can become friends with some people here. You can also reach out to so many of us mixed couples, we have all been where you are and I have met nothing but kind people.  am happy to meet up if you want or put you in contact with some people who may be your vibe if you want to write to me personally about some of your interests. You're letters need to be from Israelis but they don't need to be 10 pages long or be super in depth, I know you wrote you are introverted but try to seek some new friendships and maybe they can write the letters. Maybe you can meet people at a work out class? a gym? art class? maybe a conference. You do not need to know someone a long time to ask them for a letter. Let me know if you need anything :)
